title: Write 18 · 十 爸 热 试 差 教 冷 山 哥 风 累 肉 休 息 坏
focus: 十 爸 热 试 差 教 冷 山 哥 风 累 肉 休 息 坏
body:
Family and how you feel: 爸, 哥, 热, 冷, 累, 坏, 休息.

## Repeating parts
- **讠 speech**: on the left of 试.
- **冫 ice**: on the left of 冷. Water 氵 has 3 dots; ice 冫 has 2.
- **心 heart**: under 息.
- **灬 fire**: under 热.
- **土 earth**: on the left of 坏, where its last stroke rises.

## Rules that matter here
- **Horizontal before vertical:** 十 is 一 then 丨.
- **Dot last:** in 试 (式) the top-right 丶 goes in after the ㇂ hook.

cards.Notes: 2 strokes: 一 first, then 丨 through it (horizontal before vertical). Lookalike 干 gān has 二.
父 father + 巴 bā (phonetic). 8 strokes. 父 (丿, 丶, 丿, ㇏) on top, then 巴 (𠃍, 丨, 一, 乚).
执 zhí (phonetic) over 灬 fire. 10 strokes. 执 (扌, then 丸: 丿, ㇈, 丶), then 灬 (four dots, left to right).
讠 speech + 式 shì (phonetic). 8 strokes. 讠, then 式: the top 一, then 工, then the ㇂ hook, and the 丶 LAST.
9 strokes: 丷, three 一, then the long 丿, then 工 (一, 丨, 一). Read chà when it means "lacking", chā for "difference". Lookalike 着.
孝 xiào (phonetic) + 攵 action. 11 strokes. 孝: 土, 丿, then 子. Then 攵 (丿, 一, 丿, ㇏). Read jiāo when it means "to teach".
冫 ice + 令 lìng (phonetic). 7 strokes. 冫 (2 strokes), then 令 (人, 丶, ㇇, 丶). Ice, not water: two dots, not three.

cards.Prompt: 爬＿ · páshān · to climb a mountain
cards.Notes: Three peaks. 3 strokes: the middle 丨 first, then ㄴ (the left side and the base), then the right 丨.
Two 可 stacked. 10 strokes. In the top 可, the last stroke is a plain 丨 with no hook. The bottom 可 keeps its 亅 hook.

cards.Prompt: 刮＿ · guā fēng · the wind blows
cards.Notes: 几-shaped frame with ㄨ inside. 4 strokes: 丿, the ㇈ hook, then 丿, 丶 inside. Outside before inside.
田 field over 糸 silk. 11 strokes. 田 (5), then 糸 (𠃋, 𠃋, 丶, 亅, 丿, 丶). Read lèi when it means "tired".
Meat with ribs. 6 strokes: 丨, 𠃌, then 人 (丿, 丶) and another 人 (丿, 丶) inside. Different from ⺼, the 月-shaped body radical.
亻 person + 木 tree: a person leaning on a tree. 6 strokes. 亻 (丿, 丨), then 木 (一, 丨, 丿, 丶). Lookalike 体 tǐ adds a 一 at the bottom.
自 nose/self over 心 heart: breath. 10 strokes. 自 (丿, then 目 shape), then 心 (丶, ㇃, 丶, 丶).
土 earth + 不 (a simplified shape). 7 strokes. 土 (一, 丨, ㇀), then 不 (一, 丿, 丨, 丶).
